'''Druu''' is a [[Seanchan]] ''[[damane]]''.

== Activities ==
Her ''[[sul'dam]]'' is [[Serrah]]. She accompanies the ''[[Hailene]]'' and is under Lord [[Timak]]'s force of forty soldiers occupying the town of [[Tobin's Hollow]] on [[Toman Head]].<ref name="RPG">''[[The Wheel of Time Roleplaying Game]]''</ref>
